task_definition.task_description: Please check AAPL first, then confirm the USD-to-USD exchange rate and use that to place a $2,000 buy order with risk checks. After that, get the current time in New York, format the note “Sold 10 shares of AAPL at $150.”, and then create a high-priority app alert titled “Trip Summary” with that content and the finance and travel tags for user_001.

user_input.query: Please check AAPL first, then confirm the USD-to-USD exchange rate and use that to place a $2,000 buy order with risk checks. After that, get the current time in America/New_York, format this note exactly: “Sold 10 shares of AAPL at $150.”, and create a high-priority app alert for user_001 titled “Trip Summary” using that content. Please make sure the alert includes both tags: finance and travel.
user_input.title: Trip Summary
